artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: AMENDMENT 5: _trim_to_last_sentence_end is renamed _drop_trailing_fragment. It takes the WHOLE value text (lead line with its inline text, and every item after it, joined by a space), finds the last _SENTENCE_END match, and drops the text after it only when that text is one or two whitespace-separated words; three or more words, or no sentence end, leave the text exactly as joined. The call sits in _resolve_section_field after the block is chosen, so it never makes a served value absent or empty; the citation passage is value[:_PASSAGE_CAP] of the trimmed value; the --section-recompose-census TRIM marker and last line are unchanged (read-only, not run, reads S3). METHOD_VERSION stays amgt-corpus-dossier/7.

47 tests: the AMENDMENT 4 long-tail cut test now asserts a three-word tail STAYS; added a two-word fragment dropped, a three-word fragment stays, the real Nike shape (inline lead prose, date the only item), the Shopify shape, the abbreviation shape, and the pattern test reads _drop_trailing_fragment; the page-number test and the lone-lead test were updated to the new rule. Every edit is marked AMENDMENT 5 (CRPS-ap-6, round 40). case_unit + case_positional: 24 passed.
